# tools/list budget

<!-- Generated by `python -m hocuspocus.tools.docs --budget`, which appends a dated row to the history on every run. Do not edit by hand. -->

Bytes of the serialised `tools/list` result the bridge sends (compact JSON, as the MCP SDK writes it), per profile and `result_content` mode (BIBLE §4.1, spec-2.0 §5.1). `text` is what clients see by default (no output schemas); `both` declares them. Caps on the `full` profile (spec-2.0 §7 M3, BIBLE D44): `text` ≤ 24,000 B, `both` ≤ 34,000 B. Rows before the 2.0 cut-over measure the 1.4 profiles under `minimal`, `core` and `full`, and `v2` (1.4's full plus the 2.0 tools, spec-2.0 §7 M1-M2); from the cut-over those three are the 2.0 profiles and 1.4's full is `compat_1x`, which 2.1 removed with `v2`. `—` marks a profile that did not exist. A change that raises a number says why in its commit.
